source.alignmentAssumption: The northern source edge is treated as the rear eave of the main roof; boundary interpretation is provisional, not surveyed.

kiyomizuPlacement.method: Uniform scale from provisional north roof edge; reflected front axis; all inherited geometry transformed together.
kiyomizuPlacement.terrain: Synthetic local slope joined to illustrative district ground; no surveyed altitude.

contextPolicy.vegetation: Decorative, including pink blossom accents; not live seasonal conditions.
contextPolicy.houses: Source-side parcels with six illustrative machiya types; historic street frontages shift at most 0.65 display units. Not individual shop identification.

frontageReference.method: outward-facing road visibility with adjacent-building exclusion
frontageReference.joinery: illustrative; not an individual facade survey

description: Illustrated Higashiyama / Gion miniature: enlarged landmark silhouettes, selected illustrative machiya and low-cost decorative groves. Display scale and spacing are deliberately non-metric. Original geographic inputs remain separate; route and walking-time guidance is not yet implemented. Not a surveyed model or live flowering report.

mobileAsset.geometry: identical Float32 positions, normals, triangle order/winding and instance transforms; compiled baker light indices; no LOD; unused UV omitted

streetCraft.positionPolicy: Unchanged OSM centre lines for depicted streets; illustrative widths, paving, grades and shopfronts. Not a survey of individual stones or shops.
streetCraft.omissionReason: Three unnamed rear-access ways are retained in source data but omitted at the compressed illustration scale. This is not a complete navigable street map.
